title: Your resume is NOT about YOU
description:
What is the purpose of your resume? Your resume is a document to show the companies you apply to what you can do for them. It is NOT a list your previous jobs. You want your resume to show experience tailored for the job you’re applying for which means you want to make adjustments for every new application. #resume #resumetips #resumehelp
